name: trigpoint
description: Audit a codebase, then produce a plan of record that cannot drift. Generates a ledger, a dashboard and a design spec, and keeps them true while the work is done.

interface.shortDescription: A plan of record that cannot drift, kept true while the work is done
interface.longDescription: Trigpoint audits a codebase, runs a question ladder to produce a ledger, a dashboard and a design spec, then keeps them true. Counts are generated rather than typed. A ticked task must carry the command that proved it, and those commands are re-run as work proceeds, so a task that stopped being true unticks itself instead of quietly staying green.
